source_snapshot.procedure: Check BMC/BIOS version in BIOS and issue `ipmitool raw 0x30 0x20`; collect results/photos and post-test logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: The command succeeds and versions are correct before and after flashing.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; proposes grep-filtered `mc info` and `lspci` evidence for FPGA.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE; requires exact FPGA identity, authoritative version mapping and full read-only output.

old_problem: The Items define an FPGA-version check, but the Procedure names BMC/BIOS and labels raw `0x30 0x20` a BMC version command. Neither `lspci` enumeration nor a generic grep establishes an FPGA firmware version.
disposition_reason: The row's test identity and measurable before/after criterion make the intended property—FPGA firmware version—clear enough to specify safely. Exact FPGA instance, inventory path and raw decoder are project/platform bindings. Their absence prevents execution and PASS, but does not require the static review to stay BLOCKED. The copied BMC/BIOS method remains historical and receives no FPGA coverage credit.
decision_basis: The protected XLSX row, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2 and active historical review were all read for variant 9546a068b1a2b88e.
The operation can be restricted to read-only inventory/version collection; no flash, reset or PCI configuration write belongs to this testcase.
User rule C permits target/BDF/device mapping to be a runtime prerequisite when purpose, safety and evidence are defined.
Redfish FirmwareInventory can be discovered and used when the platform exposes the exact FPGA member; an OEM raw response requires an approved decoder and cannot be guessed.

test_case.test_name: Check the identified FPGA active firmware version before and after a separately approved flash
test_case.purpose: Read an authoritative firmware-version field for the project-selected FPGA instance and compare the same component before and after the referenced flash transaction without performing that flash in this row.
required_package: FPGA FRU/device/BDF or stable inventory identity
Platform-approved read-only version interface and, for OEM raw data, its firmware-scoped decoder
Expected before/after versions and separate flash audit reference
Authenticated BMC or host tools with protected secrets and trusted endpoints
test_case.test_command: Discover complete BMC/Redfish FirmwareInventory and/or collect the vendor-approved read-only FPGA version response for `<FPGA_ID>`; when the FPGA is a PCI endpoint, preserve `lspci -Dnnk -s <BDF>` only as identity/context. Do not use grep-only output or assume `ipmitool raw 0x30 0x20` is FPGA data without its approved decoder.
test_case.expected_result: The exact FPGA instance is present, its canonical active-version field is non-empty and decodes deterministically, the pre-flash value equals the approved source version, and the post-flash value equals the approved target version with unchanged component identity and healthy BMC/PCI/host state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires identity-bound, full before/after version evidence matching the approved matrix. FAIL covers wrong/unchanged/undecodable version or health regression after the referenced flash. A command exit code, `fpga` string or PCI enumeration alone is insufficient. BLOCK execution when identity, interface or decoder cannot be supplied.
safety_gate: No FPGA flash, reset, driver reload, PCI config write or undocumented raw command
Use protected authentication and verified host/TLS identity
Stop interpretation on multiple candidates or decoder disagreement; preserve full raw output and do not retry by changing state
expected_evidence: FPGA component identity and expected-version source
Complete inventory/member or vendor raw response plus decoder/tool versions
Pre/post comparison tied to the separate flash timestamp
test_case.recovery: A read-only mismatch requires no state recovery. Preserve the raw data, revalidate component mapping and escalate to FPGA/platform owners; do not attempt a flash or reset to make the value match.

source_conflict.preserved_original_conflict: Master Procedure still describes BMC/BIOS and raw 0x30/0x20.
source_conflict.resolution: The review-layer objective is the FPGA version named by this row; copied methods remain uncovered unless the project proves an FPGA-specific mapping.

blocked.reason: A safe read-only parameterized contract now exists; missing device identity/decoder is an execution prerequisite.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact FPGA identity, approved version interface/decoder and expected before/after values.
